tasks.notes: Raise the flag on the roof of the bank on the roof of Lumbridge Castle.

tasks.notes: Claim a herald cape from the Herald of Lumbridge.

tasks.notes: Visit the market in Draynor Village.

tasks.notes: Find out about the Rules of Conduct from the town crier in Draynor Village.

Furthermore, Explorer Jack rewards 10–4,096 coins per completed achievement.

Explorer's ring 1, which grants the following bonuses:
perks: One charge per day to replenish 50% of run energy

tasks.name: Where's The Beef?
tasks.desc: Get Beefy Bill to bank something for you.
tasks.notes:
Have Beefy Bill bank an item for them.
Beefy Bill will transport pot of flour, cowhides, or raw beef to the bank, charging a 10% commission (rounded up), or for free if charmed with an activated ring of charos. To access this feature, players must either directly talk to Beefy Bill or use the respective items on him; there is no Bank option. Beefy Bill can be found on the north side of Lumbridge, just north-east of the Mill Lane Mill.

tasks.name: Building Up Strength
tasks.desc: Create an amulet of strength, performing each step in Lumbridge. (X/7)
tasks.notes:
Create an amulet of strength, performing each step in Lumbridge.
• Using a Lvl-3 enchant tablet will not work.
• Performing any of the steps underground or in a dungeon will not work towards completing the achievement.

tasks.name: Have Your Cake and Eat It
tasks.desc: Cook a chocolate cake from scratch in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen. (X/3)
tasks.notes:
Bake a chocolate cake from scratch in the Lumbridge Castle's kitchen. For members, all ingredients can be purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest, but the cake itself must be made in the kitchen.
To bake a chocolate cake:
• Mix an egg, a bucket of milk and a pot of flour in a cake tin to create an uncooked cake.
• Bake the uncooked cake on the cooking range.
• Add a chocolate bar to the cake to create a chocolate cake (make sure to choose the "Use" option, as the default option is "Eat").

other: 19 Runecrafting Runecrafting (b) (with elemental anima stones)
tasks.notes:
Craft at least 100 water runes at once without using (or even carrying in their backpack) an explorer's ring, runecrafting pouches, or Summoning familiars.
Despite the stated 57 Runecrafting requirement, members with as low as level 19 Runecrafting can use elemental anima stones to complete this achievement. Without the elemental anima stones, 57 Runecrafting is required by carrying at least 25 essence.
